name: Raising Spirits

angles.text: Gor'mul mourns the fallen might of the Horde, questioning whether a simple trinket could ever restore the faction to its lost glory.
This task centers on reigniting the extinguished warrior spirit within an orc paralyzed by despair and grief over a cowardly strike.

faq.answer: Raising Spirits is a quest tasked with delivering a Raptor Talon Amulet to a despondent warrior named Gor'mul in hopes of rekindling his fighting spirit.
Gor'mul is a broken-spirited warrior who has succumbed to despair after witnessing the mightiest of champions fall to a coward's hand. He dismisses tokens and questions the future of the Horde.

aliases: what does raptor talon amulet do
faq.answer: The Raptor Talon Amulet is crafted from polished bone and raptor talons, offered in the hope that channeling the natural strength and ferocity of raptors can awaken Gor'mul's inner flame.
faq.q: Why is the Raptor Talon Amulet brought to Gor'mul?

faq.answer: Gor'mul has lost all hope after seeing the mightiest warriors slain by cowardice. The tragedy left him convinced that honor and strength can easily be snuffed out, breaking his will to fight.
Gor'mul rejects the gift, bitterly dismissing the amulet as mere polished bone that cannot possibly restore the Horde or undo the tragedy he laments.
faq.q: How does Gor'mul react to the amulet?

faq.answer: Gor'mul openly doubts whether the Horde can ever reclaim its former glory, seeing little hope when foul treachery can strike down even the greatest heroes.
faq.q: What does Gor'mul say about the Horde?

sections.body: Raising Spirits involves delivering a Raptor Talon Amulet to an orc named Gor'mul. His allies hope that the wild strength and ferocity of raptors, channeled through the talisman, will reawaken the warrior's flame that once burned fiercely within his veins.
sections.title: A Spark for a Fallen Flame

sections.body: Upon receiving the talisman, Gor'mul offers only bitter grief. Tormented by the memory of the mightiest champions being struck down by cowardly hands, he rejects the token as mere polished bone, questioning how any trinket could restore the Horde to its former glory.
sections.title: Bitterness and Despair

summary: Raising Spirits is a Horde quest aimed at rekindling the fighting will of Gor'mul, a broken warrior consumed by despair. An emissary delivers a Raptor Talon Amulet in hopes of awakening the fierce spirit he once possessed. However, Gor'mul remains bitter, questioning whether any simple trinket could ever mend his sorrow or restore glory to the Horde.
